description:
Configure Android's Do Not Disturb (DND) settings to allow Flight Crew View to send notifications even when DND is active.

Your specific goals are:
1. Open Android Settings and navigate to Sound or Notification settings.
2. Find 'Do Not Disturb' configurations.
3. Add 'Flight Crew View' (com.robert.fcView) to the list of apps allowed to interrupt/bypass DND.
4. Enable Do Not Disturb mode so it is currently active.

Starting state: The app is open, DND is OFF, and the app is NOT currently an exception.
